ON YOUR DEVICE

LOCAL FILES. LOCAL PROCESSING.

Read your documents.
Skip the upload.

Work with the files already on your device. Markdown Plus processes them in your browser and does not send their contents to a developer-operated server.

  • No account to create
  • No document uploads to the developer
  • Open source, with code you can inspect
See how your data is handled

SET UP ONCE. KEEP READING.

Start with a file.
Open up a workspace.

Once available, install from Chrome Web Store, allow local file access, and open a Markdown file in Chrome.

Read the full guide
  1. 01

    Install from Chrome Web Store

    Open the official Markdown Plus listing, choose Add to Chrome, then confirm Add extension. Requires Chrome 116 or newer.

  2. 02

    Allow local file access

    Enable Allow access to file URLs in Chrome’s extension details.

  3. 03

    Open your first Markdown file

    Open a local .md file in Chrome to start reading. Use the file explorer to browse related documents.
